vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you can read and borrow books
vocabulary.note_en: A bookshop sells books; a library lends them.
vocabulary.example: I study at the library.
I have a math exam tomorrow.
She is preparing for her exam.
History is my favorite subject.
We have a spelling test on Monday.
This question is difficult.
I can't remember his name.
I organize my books every week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: short pieces of writing to help you remember
vocabulary.example: Can I borrow your notes?

vocabulary.note_ar: once = مرة، twice = مرتين، three times = ثلاث مرات
vocabulary.example: I go to the gym twice a week.
Our neighborhood is quiet.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shop that sells food and things for the home
vocabulary.example: I buy milk at the grocery store.

vocabulary.meaning_en: food and things you buy for the home
vocabulary.example: I carry the groceries home.
The bus stop is in a convenient place.
The hotel has a great location.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working or studying all the normal hours
vocabulary.example: My brother has a full-time job.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working only some hours or days
vocabulary.example: She works part-time at a bookshop.
You can gain experience at work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: knowledge you get from doing something
vocabulary.example: He has work experience in sales.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small computer you can carry
vocabulary.example: I need a new laptop for school.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the middle part of a city, with many shops
vocabulary.example: The museum is in the city center.

fine_lines.title: full-time vs part-time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: full-time تعني بدوام كامل (كل الساعات العادية)، و part-time تعني بدوام جزئي (بعض الساعات أو الأيام).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Full-time is all normal working hours. Part-time is only some hours or days.

examples.sentence: I have a part-time job on weekends.

fine_lines.title: exam vs test
fine_lines.explanation_ar: exam امتحان كبير ومهم (مثل امتحان نهاية العام)، و test اختبار أقصر وأصغر عادة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: An exam is big and important. A test is usually shorter.

examples.sentence: The final exam is in June.
We have a short test every Friday.

expressions.meaning_en: Ask politely if a seat is free.
expressions.example: Excuse me, is anyone sitting here?

expressions.phrase: No, nobody is sitting here. You can sit down.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا، لا أحد يجلس هنا. يمكنك الجلوس.
expressions.example: No, nobody is sitting here. Please sit down.

expressions.phrase: Are you studying for an exam?
expressions.meaning_en: Start small talk with a student.
expressions.example: You have many books. Are you studying for an exam?

expressions.phrase: Do you come to this library very often?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تأتي إلى هذه المكتبة كثيرًا؟
expressions.example: Do you come here very often? Twice a week.

expressions.meaning_en: Say this when you find a surprising connection with someone.
expressions.example: You live on my street? What a small world!

expressions.phrase: Are you working or studying full-time?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل تعمل أو تدرس بدوام كامل؟
expressions.meaning_en: Ask about someone's work or study.
expressions.example: Are you working or studying full-time? I'm a full-time student.

expressions.phrase: It's good to gain work experience.
expressions.meaning_ar: من الجيد أن تكتسب خبرة عملية.
expressions.example: My summer job was hard, but it's good to gain work experience.

expressions.phrase: You should visit my store when you have time.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن تزور متجري عندما يكون لديك وقت.
expressions.example: You should visit my store when you have time.
Let's study together. That's a good idea!

grammar.title: How often? — frequency words
grammar.explanation_ar: لنقول كم مرة نفعل شيئًا: once a week (مرة في الأسبوع)، twice a week (مرتين)، every Sunday (كل أحد)، on weekends (في عطلات نهاية الأسبوع). وكلمات مثل usually و often تأتي قبل الفعل.
grammar.explanation_en: To say how often: once a week, twice a week, every Sunday, on weekends. Usually and often go before the verb.
examples: I come here twice a week.
I usually come here on weekends.
I buy groceries there every Sunday.

grammar.title: Present continuous for now: "I'm trying to..."
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم am/is/are + فعل ينتهي بـ ing لشيء يحدث الآن: I'm reading a book. Are you studying for an exam?
grammar.explanation_en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing for things happening now.
examples: Are you studying for an exam?
I'm reading a book for my English class.

grammar.title: Prepositions of place: near, behind
grammar.explanation_ar: near تعني قريب من، و behind تعني خلف: I live near the park, behind the grocery store.
grammar.explanation_en: near = close to; behind = at the back of.
examples: My house is behind the grocery store.
The store is near the city center.

questions.question: Excuse me, is anyone ___ here?
questions.explanation_ar: مع is نستخدم الفعل مع ing: is anyone sitting.

questions.question: I live ___ the park. I can walk here easily.
A shop that sells food for the home is a ___.
Your new friend lives on your street. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: What a small world نقولها عند اكتشاف صلة مفاجئة.
questions.explanation_en: We say it when we find a surprising connection.

questions.question: I only work two days a week. I have a ___ job.
questions.explanation_ar: العمل يومين في الأسبوع دوام جزئي part-time.
questions.explanation_en: Two days a week is part-time.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I am read a book now.
